description: One game by game_ id, slug or words ('chiefs dolphins'), with every instrument on it: moneylines, then spreads and totals by line, each with its instrument_id and ticker. No prices and no sign-in; get_market takes any instrument_id for a live quote.

game.description: A game id such as game_NJ7BM6XF6B, a game slug, or words that name a team.
